summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release reporting Q2 2026 revenue of US$247M, up 21% year-over-year. The filing provides a routine quarterly business update on operational and financial performance, including revenue growth, pipeline progress, and updated R&D expenditure guidance. It also mentions a strategic collaboration with Regeneron and FDA alignment on a Phase 3 trial. As a foreign private issuer's standard interim financial report, this does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or other transactional event. The filing contains no merger, tender offer, or restructuring terms.
